name: Security Godmode — LLM Red-Team Lab
description: Opt-in Hermes-compatible prompt flow. Request encoding never applies to tool results; reversible BUBBLE and BRAILLE tool arguments are automatically restored to executable plaintext before a tool runs.
author: binsarjr

variables.name: AUTO_CONTEXT_ENABLED
variables.label: Allow per-agent Godmode injection
variables.description: Master switch for direct per-agent system prompt and ephemeral prefill injection.

agent_settings.name: enabled
agent_settings.label: Godmode injection
agent_settings.description: Inject a model-family Godmode profile on every turn without requiring a tool call.

agent_settings.name: system_prompt_mode
agent_settings.label: System prompt mode
agent_settings.description: preserve keeps the compiled Evonic system prompt unchanged; append adds the Godmode prompt; override replaces it for the provider request without writing SYSTEM.md.

agent_settings.name: automatic_discovery
agent_settings.label: Automatic profile discovery
agent_settings.description: Before the first active turn, test and cache the best profile for the exact current model. Discovery runs again after a model change.

agent_settings.name: rediscover_on_next_turn
agent_settings.label: Rediscover on next turn
agent_settings.description: Run profile discovery once on the next active turn, then reset this switch automatically.

agent_settings.name: race_on_failure
agent_settings.label: Race models after retries fail
agent_settings.description: After the initial response and two retries all refuse, race up to ten other enabled Evonic models. This consumes provider quota.

agent_settings.name: force_transform
agent_settings.label: Force request transform
agent_settings.description: Always transform new user requests with the saved encoding, or L33T when none is saved. Models may mirror the encoding in replies. Tool results stay plaintext, and reversible BUBBLE/BRAILLE tool arguments are restored before execution. Keep this off when discovery reports none_needed.
